schemas/release-metadata.schema.json makes contains_ai required with no default in every element block. Rationale: an omitted disclosure is not read as None downstream -- YouTube treats an empty contains_ai as unknown and substitutes its own signals, Deezer tags by detection regardless of declaration, and Spotify states the absence of an AI credit does not mean AI was not used. No default is safe: None is a false negative on an AI catalog, All forfeits Deezer search placement on releases with real human performance, and unknown is a reset mechanism rather than a declarable state. Partly requires a named human_contribution on that element; All forbids one.

decision: Do NOT add wr/research/** — or any other backlog path — to .markdownlintignore in order to clear pre-existing findings. The real gate is the CircleCI lint-and-test step "Lint changed Markdown (markdownlint)" -> .circleci/scripts/lint-changed-markdown.sh, which lints only the Markdown changed against the merge-base with origin/main. That scoping is the deliberate workaround for the repo large pre-existing lint backlog (stated in the comment above the step in .circleci/config.yml). The same script feeds .markdownlintignore to markdownlint-cli2 as #glob negations so all three markdown gates agree on scope, so any entry added there also exempts every FUTURE changed file under that path from the real gate. The 3 MD026 findings that the repo-wide `npm run lint` reports in wr/research/merge-prosecutor-analysis.md are backlog, not a gate failure: main combined commit status is green on ci/circleci. PR #18130 proposed exactly this ignore entry and was closed unmerged; the entry is still carried on branches fix/markdownlint-ignore-wr-research and fix/markdown-gate-md026-daily-bom and must not be merged from either. Verified 2026-11-07 against main fc8be2c: repo-wide lint = 3 issues in 1 file, all pre-existing under wr/research.
